A row: 12 pads 0.30x0.70 at 0.50 pitch with an empty centre position (A1..A6 at -3.00..-0.50, A7..A12 at +0.50..+3.00; 6.00 overall). B row 1.70 ahead of the A row: B11..B2 0.30x0.70 at 0.50 pitch offset 0.25 (4.50 overall), B12/B1 0.80x0.70 at +-3.00 (6.00). Rear shell slots at 8.64 c-c, A row centre 0.81 behind them: slot width 0.60, copper width 1.00; slot LENGTH NOT DIMENSIONED -> R5: rear leg 1.00+-0.10 (p.1) + 0.25 = 1.25, copper 1.65 (ring 0.20 as the given widths) - check (drawing scales ~1.5). Front slots at 9.19 c-c, 5.36 ahead of the rear ones (p.1 side view): hole R0.25 (0.50) x 1.80, copper R0.45 (0.90) x 2.20. Board (SMD shell) pads 0.50x1.65, 3.41 ahead of the rear slots, in line with the front slots (abutting their copper). PCB edge 1.80 ahead of the front slots. Body 8.94x8.30, front face 1.95 ahead of the front legs (p.1).

footprints.description: 200-pin DDR2 SODIMM socket, 0.6 mm pitch, surface mount (FCI standard type)
footprints.note: 10033853.pdf (FCI drawing 10033853 rev D, 50UF SO-DIMM 0.6 mm 200 pos standard type), sheet 2 (recommended mounting PCB layout) and sheet 1: Solder-peg pads: 60.6+-0.03 between their inner edges (30.3 from the middle) and 4.5 long (3.1 from the hole axis inward to their inner edge, 4.5 +-0.03): centre 30.3+4.5/2 = 32.55; 4.6+-0.1 wide; 12+-0.05 from the hole axis. (Printed as a top view with the module going down and pin 1 at the right; turned by 180 degrees here so the module side is up and pin 1 is at the left; the odd row, upper in the print, is then the lower.)  Pads 0.35 x 2.00 (0.35+-0.03, 2+-0.05); the two contact rows of a 200 pin SODIMM are offset by half a pitch, so the footprint is generated as one 200-slot row at 0.30 pitch (odd pins one row, even pins the other, numbering 'single' with the row offset as stagger): pin 1 is 1.75 and pin 2 is 2.05 from the end hole at the pin 1 end (printed 1.75 and 2.05), pad 199 is 2.05 and pad 200 1.75 from the other end hole (mirror of the same print); pins 1..39 / 2..40 = 0.6 x 19 = 11.4, key gap 4.2 centre to centre (pin 39 to 41, pin 40 to 42, extra 4.2-0.6 = 3.6 after pin 40 in the single row), pins 41..199 / 42..200 = 0.6 x 79 = 47.4; first-to-last pad of a row 11.4+4.2+47.4 = 63.0; end holes 66.8 apart (66.8+-0.08, +-33.4 from the middle), dia 1.6+-0.1 at the pin 1 end and dia 1.1+-0.1 at the other, drawn as holes without copper (no pad printed); the footprint is centred on the middle of the two end holes. Rows 4.1 each side of the hole axis (printed 2 long, 3.1 to the pad edge nearest the axis: 3.1+2/2 = 4.1); solder-peg pads 4.5 x 4.6 at +-32.55 along the row and 12.0 from the hole axis on the module side (print). Orientation: the module side (card entry) faces up (-y); pin 1 at the left, odd pins on the lower (rear) row. Body 70.86 x 25.2 (overall plan width and depth of the print), its rear edge placed at the outer edge of the rear pad row (4.1+1.0 = 5.1 from the hole axis; the hole axis is then 7.5 below the body centre = 25.2/2 - 5.1); this edge position is read off the plan view, not printed. Body 70.86 = overall width (sheet 1 plan) and 25.2 = length of the side view (sheet 1); the depth position of the rows in it is read off the plan.

footprints.description: Samtec HSEC8 right angle 0.8 mm edge card socket, 100 positions
footprints.note: Samtec print HSEC8-1XX-XX-X-RA-XX-XX rev AQ, hsec8-1xx-xx-x-ra-xx-xx-mkt.pdf sheet 1 (Fig 1 bottom view, Table 2). The print has no recommended PCB layout; the pads are the solder tails of its bottom view, read from the PDF's vector drawing (scale 2.5:1 = 7.087 pt/mm, checked against E = 22.40 for -25): two tail rows, feet 0.23 wide x 0.90 long (1.63 pt x 6.37 pt), pitch 0.80 (printed), both rows in the same columns, odd pins in the row nearer the front face (centre 8.25 from it) and even pins in the row 1.85 behind (10.10; both measured, not printed; the odd = nearer-the-front row is an assumption from the front view where pin 01 is the lower contact row). Origin x = centre of the tail span (E = A column of Table 2: 7.20, 15.20, 23.20 one bank; 9.60, 12.80, 22.40, 34.40, 41.60, 42.40, 50.40 two banks), y = centre of the 12.05 housing depth (printed REF; front face at -6.025). Two-bank parts have a key gap of 4.00 centre to centre (A = (m-1)*0.8 + 3.2) after the first H+1 pads from pin 1 (H and J in Table 2: J = H*0.8 is the first bank's span: H = 3 / 5 / 5 / 21 / 26 / 26 / 31 for -09 / -13 / -25 / -40 / -49 / -50 / -60). The bottom view shares x with the front view (pin 01 at the left), so this top-view footprint is mirrored: pin 1 at the right. Pegs: round 1.32 (printed) and an oblong 1.10 x 1.32 (1.10 and 1.32 printed, the oblong is long in y), both 9.30 from the front face (printed) and 3.10 beyond the end tails (3.100 printed; F = E + 6.20 in Table 2), the round one at the pin-1-end side (print left, here right). Housing width K from Table 2 (11.50 .. 54.70), centred on the tails (assumption). The four 1.00 x 1.00 squares at the housing corners are not drawn (not named as pads).

The print has no recommended PCB layout; the pads are the solder tails of its bottom view, read from the PDF's vector drawing (scale 2.5:1 = 7.087 pt/mm, checked against E = 22.40 for -25): two tail rows, feet 0.23 wide x 0.90 long (1.63 pt x 6.37 pt), pitch 0.80 (printed), both rows in the same columns, odd pins in the row nearer the front face (centre 8.25 from it) and even pins in the row 1.85 behind (10.10; both measured, not printed; the odd = nearer-the-front row is an assumption from the front view where pin 01 is the lower contact row). Origin x = centre of the tail span (E = A column of Table 2: 7.20, 15.20, 23.20 one bank; 9.60, 12.80, 22.40, 34.40, 41.60, 42.40, 50.40 two banks), y = centre of the 12.05 housing depth (printed REF; front face at -6.025). Two-bank parts have a key gap of 4.00 centre to centre (A = (m-1)*0.8 + 3.2) after the first H+1 pads from pin 1 (H and J in Table 2: J = H*0.8 is the first bank's span: H = 3 / 5 / 5 / 21 / 26 / 26 / 31 for -09 / -13 / -25 / -40 / -49 / -50 / -60). The bottom view shares x with the front view (pin 01 at the left), so this top-view footprint is mirrored: pin 1 at the right. Pegs: round 1.32 (printed) and an oblong 1.10 x 1.32 (1.10 and 1.32 printed, the oblong is long in y), both 9.30 from the front face (printed) and 3.10 beyond the end tails (3.100 printed; F = E + 6.20 in Table 2), the round one at the pin-1-end side (print left, here right). Housing width K from Table 2 (11.50 .. 54.70), centred on the tails (assumption). The four 1.00 x 1.00 squares at the housing corners are not drawn (not named as pads).

footprints.note: Samtec print ERI8-XXX-X-D-RA-X-XR rev F, eri8-xxx-x-d-ra-x-xr-mkt.pdf sheet 1 (Fig 1: front view, plan view, bottom view, Section A-A, Table 2). Origin: the centre of the 8.40 [.331] REF deep, A wide housing outline (A = 19.08 / 28.68), which is also the centre of the tails. footprints.description: Samtec MEC1 EM2 straddle-mount 1.0 mm edge card socket, 100 positions
footprints.note: Samtec print MEC1-1XX-XX-XX-D-EMX-XX-XX rev T, mec1-1xx-xx-xx-d-emx-xx-xx-mkt.pdf sheet 1 (top view, front view, Section A-A, Table 3). Straddle-mount edge connector for a 1.57 (.062) thick board (option EM2, the only one in the catalogue parts): the board edge is the housing's rear face, y = +4.445 here (housing 8.89 deep, .3500 [8.89] REF, centred on y = 0, card entry up); the tails run D = 4.95 [.195] onto the board (Table 3, EM2, D +-.020; the front view shows .1850 [4.70] REF, the EM1 value). Section A-A shows the two tail rows one each side of the board (B = 1.37 apart for EM2, Table 3), so odd pins (row 01) are pads on the part's face and even pins (row 02) the opposite face, in the same columns; which face is which is an assumption (the print does not say). Tail pads 0.36 wide (.0140 [0.36] REF printed at the tail) x 4.95 long, pitch 1.00 (printed: .03937 [1.000]), first-to-last (No OF POS - 1) x 1.0 (printed). No tail gap: the polarization ribs of Table 2 are card keys, every pin position carries a contact. Pin 01 at the left of the top view (assumption: footprint's pin 1 side). Origin: x = centre of the tail span (assumption), y = housing centre. Housing width (No OF POS + 2) x 1.0 + 12.45 (printed REF, top view). The end wings / weld tabs are not drawn (no pad size printed).

The print has no recommended PCB layout; the pads are the solder feet of its bottom view, read from the PDF's vector drawing (scale 2:1 = 5.669 pt/mm, checked against E = 19.00 for the -20 shown and the 22.00 peg distance H): tails 0.36 wide (2.02 pt; .0140 [0.36] class value), 0.91 long (.036 [0.91] TYP printed), pitch 1.00 (printed), both rows in the same columns; first-to-last tail E = (No OF POS - 1) x 1.0 (Table 3: 4.00 .. 69.00). Foot toes from the housing's front face: bottom contact row 10.06 (.396 [10.06]) and top row 11.96 (.471 [11.96]), both printed in Section A-A, so the feet span 9.15..10.06 and 11.05..11.96 (centres 9.605 and 11.505; row-to-row 1.90). Odd pins (row 01, the lower contact row in the front view) are the row nearer the front: assumption. Origin: x = centre of the tail span (the pegs are symmetric about it), y = centre of the 11.68 housing depth (.460 [11.68] REF; front face at -5.84), so rows at y = 9.605 - 5.84 = 3.765 and 11.505 - 5.84 = 5.665. The bottom view shares x with the front view, where pin 01 is at the left, so this top-view footprint is mirrored: pin 1 at the right. Housing width D = (No OF POS) + 4.54 (Table 3 D: 9.54 .. 74.54).

footprints.description: Samtec MEC5 right angle 0.5 mm edge card socket, 140 positions
footprints.note: Samtec print MEC5-XXX-XX-X-RA-XX-XR rev E, mec5-xxx-xx-x-ra-xx-xr-mkt.pdf sheet 1 (Fig 1 bottom view, Table 1). The print has no recommended PCB layout; the pads are the solder feet of its bottom view, read from the PDF's vector drawing (scale 3:1 = 8.504 pt/mm, checked against E = 27.00 for the -050 shown): feet 0.23 wide (1.96 pt) x 0.90 long (7.6 / 7.7 pt), pitch 0.50 (printed: 0.500+-0.070), the two rows in the same columns and 3.10 apart centre to centre (26.35 pt, measured, not printed). Tail span E = (No OF POS - 1) x 0.5 (-030: 14.50, -040: 19.50) or, with the key gap, (No OF POS + 4) x 0.5 (-070: 37.00, -080: 42.00; Table 1). The key gap is 3.00 centre to centre (3.00+-0.10 printed) after the first D/0.5 + 1 tails from pin 01 (D = 18.50 for -070, 21.00 for -080; no gap for -030 / -040: 'polarization rib is not present on -030 & -040'). The bottom view shares x with the front view (pin 01 at the left), so this top-view footprint is mirrored: pin 1 at the right. Odd pins (row 01) are the row nearer the front (assumption), i.e. y = -1.55; even pins +1.55. The print does not locate the housing relative to the feet: the origin is the middle of the two foot rows (x centred on the tails), the housing is drawn A wide (Table 1: 23.38 / 28.38 / 45.88 / 50.88 = No OF POS x 0.5 + 8.38, +2.50 with the key gap) and 5.45 deep (5.45 REF), centred on that origin - an approximation. Weld tabs (W2) and pegs are not drawn.

footprints.description: TE 166088 AMP-Edge board-to-board card-edge connector, 13 posts, 2.54 mm pitch, one row of through-hole posts
footprints.note: TE customer drawing C-166088 (rev H2), datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/166088.pdf, sheet 1 of 1. Posts: 13 at pitch 2.54 (N-1) x 2.54 = 30.48 printed; post hole 0.8 mm min dia printed ('board to board contact post for 0.8 min dia hole') -> drill 0.8; pad diameter 1.6 NOT printed (assumed). Row y = +2.54: the print shows two possible post rows 5.08 apart in section A-A (5.08 printed), the single-loaded row is the left one in section A-A, which is the lower row (+y) of the top view; 2.54 = 5.08/2 (symmetric about the housing centre, scaled 2.5 on the print); the sign is read from the section direction, not printed. Origin: centre of the top-view outline 53.08 x 10.2 (53.08 printed, depth 10.2 printed in section A-A). Two housing ear holes 47.08 apart (printed), 3.4 high x 4 wide on the print (clipped circle): drawn as non-plated round holes of 3.4 mm (the 4 mm width is not expressible); plating and PCB use of the ear holes not printed. No PCB layout is printed; pin 1 assumed at the left. Card slot runs along x; the card is inserted perpendicular to the board.

footprints.description: TE 1717831 mini PCI Express / mSATA card-edge socket, 52 contacts, 0.8 mm pitch, surface mount
footprints.note: TE customer drawing C-1717831 (rev E), datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/1717831.pdf, sheet 2 'referential P.C.board layout for full card connector' (sheet 1 for the 29.8 x ~9.5 outline and the pin-1 triangle). Datum = centre of the O1.6 hole (x 0, y 0 on the print). Pads 0.6 x 2.0, pitch 0.8, 2 rows at y = -4.1 / +4.1 (4.1 printed). Odd pins (pin 1 marked by the triangle on sheet 1) on the lower row, first centre x = 0.7; even pins on the upper row, first centre x = 1.1 (0.4 REF stagger); 8 pads (0.8 x 7 = 5.6), then the key: second group starts at 10.3 (odd) / 10.7 (even) with 18 pads (0.8 x 17 = 13.6). Pegs: pads 2.3 x 3.2 centred at x = -2.15 and 27.15, y = +3.5 (2.15, 27.15, 3.5, 2.3, 3.2 printed); holes O1.6 at x = 0 and O1.1 at x = 25 (25 printed), y = 0. Plating of these holes not printed: drawn non-plated. Footprint origin = housing centre: x = 12.5 (25/2, the print's housing is 30 wide, 2.5 outside the two holes, read from the scaled outline); y = +0.23 (outline top/bottom read off the scaled sheet-1 plan view, 9.5 deep: approximate). So every printed x is shifted by -12.5, every y by -0.23. The housing body 29.8 x 9.5 is approximate in y.

footprints.description: TE 1734774 PCI Express card-edge socket, 164 contacts, 1.0 mm pitch, vertical through-hole
footprints.note: TE customer drawing C-1734774 (rev H1), datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/1734774.pdf, sheet 4 'recommended PCB layout' (sheets 1 and 2 for the table of DIM F / DIM G and the 14.50 / B housing). Four staggered rows of holes: A odd pins (A1, A3, ..) on the inner row y = -1.25, A even on the outer row y = -3.25, B odd inner +1.25, B even outer +3.25 (rows 2.50 apart inner and 6.50 outer printed, inner 1.25 / 1.25 / 3.25 printed); pitch along x 1.00 (printed), so each row has a 2.00 pitch; hole O0.7 +-0.08 -> drill 0.7; pad diameter 0.9 NOT printed (assumed: the largest round pad whose box stays clear of the O2.35 key hole, whose edge is 1.65 - 1.175 = 0.475 from A11 and 1.35 - 1.175 from A12's row). Key centre line x = 0 (in the key frame): A11 at -1.65, A12 at +1.35 (printed), A1 at -11.65 (11.65 printed; 10.00 A1-A11), last A pin at 1.35 + F; DIM F = N/2 - 12 (6, 20, 37, 70 printed); the key gap is 3.00 between A11 and A12 (extra 2.00). B pins have the same x as the A pins (B1 under A1). Mounting holes O2.35 (2 places) at the key (x = 0) and at DIM G = F + 3.15 (9.15, 23.15, 40.15, 73.15 printed); plating not printed, drawn non-plated. Origin: centre of the housing outline, which spans 14.50 left of the key to B - 14.50 right of it, B = F + 19 (25, 39, 56, 89 printed): housing centre at (F - 10)/2 right of the key, so every key-frame x is shifted by +(10 - F)/2 (the pads end up 0.15 left of the housing centre, hence x_off -0.15). Housing depth 7.40 (printed), assumed centred on the rows (y = 0).

Board edge: y = +6.225 (the housing is 15.49 deep, y -7.745..+7.745, and the board edge datum N is 13.97 from the card-entry face: -7.745 + 13.97); the board lies at +y of that edge, so pads run from the edge to 6.35 (printed 6.35 MIN) = centre y 9.4; the card-entry face is at -y. 19 pad positions per face at 2.54 (18 spaces = 45.72 printed), 1.27 wide (printed 1.27 +-0.05): 3 power contacts of 3 posts each (the 9 left posts, 7.62 between contact centres as printed: 2X 7.62) then 10 single contacts (9X 2.54 = 22.86 printed); every post of a contact is a pad with the contact's pin number. Pin numbering is NOT printed on the layout: only the mating card's pads 14..26 are named (pad 26 = leftmost wide pad, pad 14 = rightmost single). Assumed: the opposite face is numbered the same way, pad n directly across the board from pad n+13 (pins 1..13 own face, 14..26 opposite face), and numbering runs from the right end (single pads) to the wide pads on both faces. Ear holes 3.68 dia, 62.87 apart (+-31.435), 1.65 above the board edge (5.75 - 4.11 = 1.64 printed arithmetic): y = 6.225 - 1.65 = 4.575, drawn non-plated (plating not printed). Land pattern taken from the sibling drawing 10165968 rev A 'PCI Express Gen 6, SMT Type' (PDF datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10165968c.pdf, sheet 3 'RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT, PAD TYPE', 164 POSITION row of the table), assumed identical for the Gen 4/5 vertical SMT (catalog: 'footprint compatible with PCIe 3/2/1'). Printed: pitch 1.00, pad width 0.53 +-0.05, pad length 2.00 +-0.05, pad row centres 3.60 either side of the centre line (row A top, row B bottom, as seen from the top of the board with #A1/#B1 at the left), A1..A11 = 10 spaces at 1.00 (10.00), A12..A82 = DIM J = 70.00 (70 spaces), key: A11 to A12 = 3.00 (hole axis 1.65 right of A11 and 1.35 left of A12), so a gap of 3.00-1.00 = 2.00 after pad 11; A1 to A82 = 10+3+70 = 83.00; locating hole dia 1.2 +-0.05 on the centre line at A11+1.65 (axis of datum Z); tabs: rectangle 3.00 x 5.00 (2X 3.00 +-0.05, 2X 5.00 +-0.05) 1.50 beyond the end pad on each end (DIM H = 92.00 for 164 = 83.00 + 2*(1.50+3.00): the left tab spans A1-4.50..A1-1.50, the right A82+1.50..A82+4.50, centres at +-3.00 from the end pads); right tab has a dia 1.80 +-0.05 hole whose centre is 0.30 inside the tab's inner edge (DIM K = 73.15 from the key hole to that centre: 11.65+73.15 = 84.80 = 84.50+0.30). The two 3.00 x 5.00 rectangles are NOT drawn as pads: the print does not name them (hold-down solder pad or keep-out is unknown) and the right one is cut by the dia 1.80 hole (a pad and a hole would overlap, which the footprint loader refuses); the dia 1.80 and dia 1.20 holes are drawn non-plated (the print does not say plated). footprints.note: Amphenol drawing 10173133 rev A (PCI Express 6.0 assembly, straddle mount type), datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10173133.pdf, sheet 2 'Recommended PCB layout' (pad sizes and lengths), sheet 1 (housing and mounting ears), table col DIM D = 92.60. BOARD EDGE: the connector straddles the PCB edge; the board edge is the line y = +5.00 (the footprint's body, 10.00 deep from sheet 1 mid view '10.00' above the board edge line, occupies y -5.00 .. +5.00 outside the board; the board lies at y > 5.00). Origin x = centre of the A1..A82 extent (housing DIM B = 89.00 = L0 + 6.0), y = housing centre. Pads 0.60 wide, their inner ends 3.20 from the board edge (y = 8.20); signal pads 1.60 long (y 6.60..8.20) and the ground pads listed in the print's note 1 (A12,A15,A18,A20,A23,A24,A27,A28,A31,A34,A37,A38,A41,A42,A45,A46,A49,A51,A54,A55,A58,A59,A62,A63,A66,A67,A70,A71,A74,A75,A78,A79,A82 and B13,B16,B18,B21,B22,B25,B26,B29,B32,B35,B36,B39,B40,B43,B44,B47,B49,B52,B53,B56,B57,B60,B61,B64,B65,B68,B69,B72,B73,B76,B77,B80) 2.50 long (y 5.70..8.20, 0.70 from the edge): the long pads are the 1.60 pad plus a touching 0.90 x 0.60 pad of the same pin (y 5.70..6.60). Pitch 1.00; A1..A11, key 3.00 (A11 to A12 = 1.50 + 1.50 about the key centre line), then A12..A82 (70 spaces, table N). A pads are on the footprint's own face (pins 1..82 = A1..A82), B pads (pins 83..164 = B1..B82) are on the far face ('opposite') at the same x and y: the print shows the two faces as two views labelled PIN A1 / PIN B1 with B1 under A1 but does not say which face is top (assumed A on the part's face). Two non-plated (assumed, M2 screw holes) 2.30 +/-0.05 holes 2.50 from the board edge (y = 7.50) at 16.30 from the key centre line, i.e. 4.80 outside A1 / A82 (DIM D = hole to hole = 92.60 = L0 + 2 x 4.80). The hatched keep-out areas and the cap are not drawn. L0 = 83.00.

footprints.note: Amphenol drawing 10181068 rev 3 (M.2 Gen5 RVS connector, M key 1.88H), datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10181068.pdf, sheet 2 'Recommended PCB layout' (viewed from the top of the board; pin 1 is at the right). Contacts are numbered in M.2 order skipping the key: contact c = M.2 pin c for c <= 58, contact 59..67 = M.2 pins 67..75; odd pins on one row (side 0, 34 pads, pitch 0.50, 29 pads pin 1..57 then key then pins 67..75: 57 to 67 = 2.50, extra gap 2.00; span 18.50 printed), even pins on the other row (33 pads, pin 2..58, 68..74: 58 to 68 = 2.50; span 18.00 printed); pin n sits 0.25 left of pin n-1 (pin 1 to pin 2 offset 0.25 printed), so both rows are centred on the connector centre line (9.25 and 9.00 from it, printed). Pads 0.30 +/-0.03 x 1.10 +/-0.03. Rows 2.40 apart: with the two locating holes at y_h, the even row is y_h - 2.05, the odd row y_h + 0.35 (printed 2.05 and 0.35). Origin: x = connector centre line, y = midpoint of the two pad rows (y_h - 0.85); the housing's position relative to the pads is not dimensioned on the print, so the outline (23.80 x 8.75 overall, sheet 1 plan view) is only centred there. Holes (non-plated assumed): dia 1.20 +/-0.05 at 11.00 left (y_h = +0.85) and dia 1.70 +/-0.05 at 11.00 right. Two 1.20 x 2.75 +/-0.05 solder-tab pads (pin 0, surface mount as printed: no hole is dimensioned) at x = +/-11.385 (printed 11.385 from the centre line), 4.97 below y_h (y = +5.82). The PCB cut-out edge is 1.80 below y_h (y = +2.65); the printed 5.40 and the 4.20/6.50 standoff circle are not drawn.

Even pins (33 pads, lower row): pin 2 .. pin 58 (14.00), 58 to 68 = 2.50, 68 to 74 = 1.50, total 18.00, 9.00 from the centre line (printed). Pads 0.30 +/-0.03 x 1.55 +/-0.03, pitch 0.50. Solder tabs pins 76 / 77 (printed 'PTH', 1.20 +/-0.03 x 2.75 +/-0.03, centres 10.35 from the centre line, 4.50 above y_h): a plated slot hole 1.20 x 2.75; the print gives no pad size, so the copper is assumed 1.40 x 2.95 (0.10 ring), pin 0.
